messages:
erin: Putting this here after the design sync. Proposal: unify Models/Pipelines/Jobs under 'Workloads' in the left rail, but also define a compact mobile pattern where the left rail collapses to a bottom sheet. Need rules for breadcrumbs, deeplinks, and copy. Opinions?

jacob: Useful for small viewports. Important: breadcrumb behavior must be deterministic across breakpoints. My suggestion: breadcrumb shows full path on desktop, a 2-segment compressed version on tablet, and a single tappable 'path pill' on mobile that opens a small overlay with full path.

priya: Agree. Also, for mobile we must preserve shareable URLs. Deep links should continue to resolve even if the UI uses a bottom sheet. So route contract stays `/app/:org/workloads/:kind/:id`. When a mobile route loads, open the sheet and focus the item row. Don't auto-scroll the main page.

noah: Engineering notes: backend will keep legacy redirects for /models/ etc. Client will router.replace legacy -> canonical to avoid extra history. Edge-case: bookmark files from older emails containing query params like `?view=details`. We should normalize those into canonical routes and carry the query if needed. Example: `/app/orgX/models/12?view=details` -> `/app/orgX/workloads/models/12?view=details`.

erin: Breadcrumb microcopy idea: show human-friendly type labels: Models -> "Models (M)", Pipelines -> "Pipelines (P)" in tooltips and the compact pill. Helps recognition if top-level label disappears.

jacob: Accessibility: when a deeplink triggers sheet/sidelist expansion, announce "Models list opened" via aria-live polite. For keyboard users on desktop collapsed nav, ensure group header receives focus and an expand keystroke (Enter/Space) is supported.

priya: UX detail: animating open should be subtle (160ms) and not change scroll. Implement focus-without-scroll: focus(element, {preventScroll: true}) then animate; once animation finishes, ensure element is visible in its container. Also keep router history to a single replace + push for the final route if needed.

noah: Telemetry: add events `nav.deeplink.resolve`, `nav.legacy_redirect`, `nav.compact_open` with fields: org, kind, method (link/button/search), viewport. That lets product measure breakage across breakpoints.

erin: Docs/migration: we'll publish a short migration guide mapping legacy patterns and providing curls. Also update the quickstart snippets that reference `/models/`. Priya, can you compile a list of example legacy links we need to map?

priya: Yep. I'll also run a small discovery test with 10 users to watch how they find models after the group change. Suggest we include a pinned search affordance: when someone searches "models" the fallback shows a one-click open-group action.

jacob: One more accessibility nit: when the bottom sheet opens on mobile, ensure it traps focus and has a clear close button with aria-label. Also announce the sheet with role="dialog" aria-modal="true" for screen readers.

erin: Great. Plan: 1) router redirects + query-preserving normalize (noisy links handled), 2) prototype mobile sheet + desktop compact rail behavior with focus/preventScroll, 3) telemetry + docs, 4) small beta. Owners: @noah redirects/tests, @priya research + examples, @jacob a11y checklist, @erin prototype. audit-bot: reminder: add rollout checklist to the design review doc.

noah: I'll add e2e tests: deep-link desktop collapsed nav, deep-link mobile sheet open, legacy redirect with query preserved, and history entry count assertions.

priya: I'll prepare the 10-user script and the list of legacy URLs.

jacob: I'll write the keyboard flow and screen reader scenarios (NVDA/VoiceOver) and include focus timing guidance for the devs.

erin: OK locking this as the working plan unless objections by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
